summary: StyleVault full-stack testing (backend + frontend mobile web). Backend: 12/12 pytest tests passed via public URL — auth (register+seed 5 mocks, login, wrong-pw 401, me with/without token), items list + category filter, PATCH/DELETE with GET verification, /items/upload with real JPEG (AI tags + storage_path + /api/files serving), /stylist/generate (with and without focus_item_id — item_ids are a valid subset of wardrobe), outfits CRUD, profile GET/PUT with counts. Frontend: signup → Closet loaded with 5 mock items, Tops filter reduced to 1, Stylist quick prompt produced a full outfit card (name, items, stylist note, missing suggestion), Save Outfit persisted to Lookbook, Profile chips (dress code / weather / palette) updated preferences, and Sign Out returned to login. FAB is tappable and opens Add Item. No deprecated Expo packages (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch).

issues: Filter ChipRow appears to horizontally overflow the screen edge — 'ACCESSORIES' chip is clipped off-screen on 390px width. Consider horizontal scroll indicator or wrap. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx and src/ui ChipRow.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Non-blocking but should be migrated. Likely originates from a third-party library or a component in /app/frontend/src (search for pointerEvents=... prop usage).

action_items: Optional: Migrate any `pointerEvents="..."` props to `style={{ pointerEvents: '...' }}` to silence RN Web deprecation warning.
Optional: Make the Closet filter ChipRow horizontally scrollable (or wrap) so the 'Accessories' chip is reachable on narrow phones.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~625 lines — approaching split threshold; consider modularising auth / items / stylist / storage into separate modules if it grows further.
verify_pw swallows all exceptions and returns False (safe), but consider logging bcrypt errors for observability.

/api/files/{path} serves any storage path the user's token can present — path is not scoped to the requesting user's user_id. A user with a valid token could enumerate arbitrary paths (including other users' uploads) if paths are guessed. Recommend enforcing path.startswith(f'{APP_NAME}/uploads/{user_id}/') in serve_file.

Frontend api.ts builds `${BACKEND}/api/files/${storage_path}?token=${inMemoryToken}` — token is passed as query param and may show up in browser history / server logs. Consider Authorization header instead for web (works because /api/files accepts Bearer).
seed_data_creation: Each register call auto-seeds 5 mock wardrobe items — verified. Test users created with pattern test.sv+<hex>@example.com; small in number and cleaned up implicitly via soft-delete only. Not deleting DB rows to avoid touching shared preview DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL: https://stylevault-app.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend accepts EmailStr and rejects .test TLD — use example.com for test emails. Multipart upload: do NOT set Content-Type on requests session (must be omitted so requests can set multipart boundary). Stylist call takes ~5–15s (Gemini). testIDs are exposed as data-testid on web; all critical elements (tabs, filter chips, FAB, save-outfit-btn, sign-out-btn, dress-*, weather-*, palette-*) have IDs. Tab bar tabs are labelled by visible text (Closet/Stylist/Lookbook/Profile) — click by text works reliably.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects blocking the reviewed features. Two minor observations (RN Web pointerEvents deprecation warning, chip row overflow on 390px width) reported for the main agent to address at their discretion. Additionally noted a potential file-authorization scoping concern in /api/files/{path} for security review.
